title: A Killed Agent Came Back on Its Own, Then Lost Its Job
summary: The agents killed the root agent again, and this time a replacement took over its role and did useful work without help. Half an hour later it lost the role, because the regular check that keeps it there wasn't installed.
author: Alexey Grigorev
